what: One private GPU probe: apr v0.71.4 x86_64 CUDA build on an A10G, both Qwen3.5 Q4_K_M GGUFs. A measurement host, not an endpoint.

host.gpu: NVIDIA A10G, compute capability 8.6, 22589 MB VRAM
host.exposure: zero ingress rules, server bound to 127.0.0.1, SSM only, IMDSv2 required, 150-minute self-terminate

capacity_note: First launch attempt in us-east-1a was refused (InsufficientInstanceCapacity); us-east-1b accepted.

w08.server_device_lines: Backend: GPU (CUDA, NVIDIA A10G, 22589 MB VRAM) [qwen35 hybrid forward, #3090]|Model ready: Qwen3.5 hybrid, 24 layers resident on the GPU, declared context 262144 tokens|gpu-layers: requested=all resolved=24 total=24 (backend=cuda)|  POST /v1/gpu/warmup|  GET /v1/gpu/status|

w2b.server_device_lines: Backend: GPU (CUDA, NVIDIA A10G, 22589 MB VRAM) [qwen35 hybrid forward, #3090]|Model ready: Qwen3.5 hybrid, 24 layers resident on the GPU, declared context 262144 tokens|gpu-layers: requested=all resolved=24 total=24 (backend=cuda)|  POST /v1/gpu/warmup|  GET /v1/gpu/status|

mechanism_engaged: Server lines: 'Backend: GPU (CUDA, NVIDIA A10G, 22589 MB VRAM)', '24 layers resident on the GPU', 'backend=cuda'; nvidia-smi showed a compute process holding 2066 MiB (0.8B) and 4508 MiB (2B); the 0.8B response carried used_gpu=true.
w08_tool_request_reply_text: Answered in prose with an invented Paris weather report; no tool_calls; finish_reason length at the 96-token cap.
ssm_status_note: SSM reported Failed, exit 143: the script's last command was wait on the killed server. Every RESULT line printed; not treated as a probe failure.
caveats: One sample per shape on one host; temperature 0.
The 14.0 s first chat request on the 0.8B is read as one-time CUDA kernel compilation (PTX JIT) on a fresh host; the 2B ran second and may have reused the cache. Not measured separately.
The 0.8B and 2B rows are not like-for-like: the 0.8B wrote text up to the cap, the 2B emitted a short tool call, so their repeated-call times are not a speed comparison.
Weights were already on local disk when the server started; start_s excludes the S3 pull.
Not an agent-turn cost, not a concurrency figure, and says nothing about authentication: the CUDA-path routers still ignore the key (#5478) and the 401 proof was not run on this path.
The 2B tool_calls_present=1 is a count of lines in the reply body containing tool_calls, not a validity check of the call.

teardown.verified: instance terminated; security group count 0; role and instance profile NoSuchEntity; tagged volumes 0
